queries: select date_trunc('week',date) w, count(*) n, count(distinct customer_id) c from campaign_buyer group by 1 order by 1
select date_trunc('week',date) w, count(*) n from lost_sale group by 1 order by 1

select p.supplier_id, count(distinct s.product_id) zero_prods, count(*) zero_days from stock_snapshot s join product p on p.id=s.product_id where s.value=0 and s.date between '2025-03-31' and '2025-04-27' group by 1
select date_trunc('week',date) w, sum(quantity) q from supplier_delivery where date>='2025-03-10' and date<'2025-05-12' group by 1 order by 1
